articles.title: FDA Caught Burying Evidence of COVID Vaccine Risks in Children — Deaths Went Unwarned
articles.summary: The FDA has been sitting on evidence linking COVID vaccines to serious risks in children, including deaths, while failing to act on internal recommendations to issue warnings. No regulatory action has been taken, leaving parents uninformed and children unprotected. This is regulatory suppression of safety data at the highest level of the public health apparatus.

articles.title: NIH Virologist Proposed Engineering Coronavirus With Furin Cleavage Site Weeks Before Pandemic Began
articles.summary: Newly surfaced emails show NIH virologist Vincent Munster proposed inserting a furin cleavage site into a coronavirus spike protein on October 6, 2019 — the exact genetic feature at the center of the lab-leak debate. This directly implicates NIH-linked researchers in the functional blueprint of SARS-CoV-2. The emails were not volunteered; they had to be dragged into the light.

articles.title: McCullough Foundation Epidemiologist: mRNA Shots Are the Deadliest Product Ever Deployed — And Flu Vaccine Data Was Faked
articles.summary: Nicolas Hulscher, epidemiologist with the McCullough Foundation, lays out a systematic case that COVID mRNA injections represent the most lethal medical product in recorded history, while simultaneously exposing decades of flu vaccine fraud and suppressed data on natural cancer treatments. The interview names institutions, mechanisms of suppression, and body counts that the captured mainstream press refuses to cover.

articles.title: Theranos Whistleblower Tyler Shultz Scorches New Holmes Documentary for Sanitizing a Fraudster
articles.summary: Tyler Shultz, the Theranos insider who risked everything to expose Elizabeth Holmes' blood-testing fraud, says the new documentary 'You Can See Everything' renders Holmes 'almost unrecognizable' — softening a convicted fraudster who endangered patient lives with fabricated diagnostic data. Shultz's criticism cuts to the heart of how media narratives rehabilitate those who corrupt medical science for profit. The real story is the patients whose health decisions were based on fraudulent lab results.

articles.title: Curcumin Targets Fibrosarcoma Cells While Sparing Healthy Tissue — Peer-Reviewed Data Big Pharma Ignores
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study out of Wroclaw Medical University demonstrates that curcumin — an unpatentable plant compound — shows selective anticancer activity against fibrosarcoma cells while leaving healthy muscle cells intact. This adds to a growing body of research on metabolic and botanical cancer interventions that receive no pharma funding and minimal clinical development. No patent, no pipeline, no press release.

articles.title: Decanoic Acid Slashes Inflammation and Could Replace High-Dose Steroids — Where's the Clinical Trial?
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study in PLOS ONE shows decanoic acid — a medium-chain fatty acid found in coconut oil — additively suppresses IL-1β inflammatory signaling and enables significant dose-sparing of dexamethasone, a steroid with well-documented serious side effects. If a patentable drug showed this profile in macrophage models, it would be fast-tracked. Because it's a fatty acid, it sits in a journal and goes nowhere.

articles.title: Sunlight: The Essential Nutrient With No Lobbyists and a Mountain of Suppressed Evidence
articles.summary: Dr. Joseph Mercola documents the growing body of research showing artificial lighting and sunlight deprivation are driving chronic disease — from metabolic dysfunction to cancer — while the medical establishment pushes sunscreen and sun avoidance. Because no pharmaceutical company can profit from sunlight, the research is systematically underfunded, ignored in clinical guidelines, and buried beneath SPF marketing. The conflicts writing public health guidance on UV exposure run directly through the dermatology-pharma complex.

articles.title: Hibsago Approved With Boxed Warning — FDA Greenlit a Hepatitis B Drug That Can Cause Liver Reactions and Platelet Collapse
articles.summary: The FDA approved GSK's bepirovirsen (Hibsago) for chronic hepatitis B with a boxed warning — the agency's most serious safety flag — for severe liver reactions and thrombocytopenia. While the drug shows functional cure potential in roughly 1 in 5 patients off treatment, the boxed warning signals serious risks that the approving press release buries under 'breakthrough' framing. Patients deserve the full risk picture, not a marketing headline.

articles.title: FDA Caught Suppressing Vaccine Risk Evidence for Children — Deaths on Record, Warnings Still Blocked
articles.summary: The FDA has been sitting on evidence of COVID vaccine risks in children, including deaths, while refusing to act on recommendations for updated warnings. This is regulatory capture in its most lethal form — an agency whose mandate is safety choosing silence over accountability. Children have paid the price while bureaucrats ran out the clock.

articles.title: Shingles Vaccine Stats Are a Con Job — Brownstone Exposes the Numbers Game Big Pharma Plays on Patients
articles.summary: Brownstone Institute's Alan Cassels dismantles the statistical sleight-of-hand used to sell shingles vaccines to the public, revealing how relative risk reduction figures are weaponized to obscure marginal absolute benefits. This is the same playbook used across the vaccine and statin industries to manufacture consent through deliberately misleading data presentation. Patients are being bamboozled by design, not accident.

articles.title: mRNA Shots Called 'Deadliest Product in History' — McCullough Foundation Epidemiologist Lays Out the Case

This is what happens when epidemiologists work outside pharma funding.

No patent, no lobbyists, no NIH funding stream means one of the most evidence-supported health interventions in human history gets actively undermined by dermatology and oncology guidelines. The population is being kept indoors and sick while sunscreen manufacturers collect billions.
